name: How long does a typical kitchen layout change project take from design to completion?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen layout change project take from design to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen layout change project varies significantly based on its complexity and the extent of structural modifications. A comprehensive renovation involving major layout changes, plumbing, and electrical work can typically take anywhere from 8 to 20 weeks, including design, permitting, demolition, and construction phases. Smaller reconfigurations might be quicker. We work closely with clients to establish a realistic timeline during the planning stages, aiming for efficiency without compromising quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen layout change can take 8-20 weeks, depending on complexity, from design through construction. Smaller changes may be quicker.
